correctness.rationale: Gaussian subordination gives the radial exponential Fourier transform C_d lambda (lambda^2+||xi||^2)^(-(d+1)/2). Differentiating in lambda at 1 for r and r^2 gives the exact nonnegative-spectral quadratic Q_{d,a,b}(u)=1-a+(d+1)(a-3b)u+(d+1)(d+3)b u^2 on u=1/(1+||xi||^2) in [0,1]. Independent symbolic derivatives rederived this polynomial. Bochner equivalence and elementary vertex/end-point minimization give the exact four semialgebraic regions for b<=0 and b>0, the a=0 interval [-1/(d(d+1)),4(d+3)/(9(d+1))], and dimension-uniform [0,4/9]. Density is positive away from at most two frequency spheres so all finite distinct-site Gram matrices are strictly positive definite; independent rational CHECK.py examples verify boundary algebra but the general theorem is analytic.
